title: Tick q1e's description said the feed-line half 'landed in no open tick', but it had landed with emk before q1e was filed
body: 1a7f811 (merged via tick-emk/attempt-15, before q1e's creation timestamp) already implements the wall_clock_fired feed line, its once-per-tick guard and its marker-arithmetic derivation; the tick record reads as if both halves were open, which sent this worker to re-verify the run half rather than trust the record. A note on the tick (or on future split-out ticks) stating what a sibling attempt already landed would save the re-verification; no code change is needed — the half is present and tested.
